comparison_method: Normalize dialogue for comparison only, compare all 19 preferred recordings to every one of 170 Zoom exports using five-word sequence overlap, then ordered word alignment on the top four candidates. Inspect unmatched passages for high-overlap calls. Raw originals are never normalized or rewritten.
limitations: Same-call overlap does not mean exact transcription equality; originals and differences are retained.
Five paired alternatives are metadata-identified captures and were not downloaded or content-compared.
Additional classification is relative to the 170 supplied local Zoom files.
Native source speaker attribution is preserved, not corrected or asserted verified against audio.
